description: This file implements a transformation pass that scalarizes vector and matrix constructor arguments in shader code, to avoid driver bugs by ensuring constructor arguments are scalar or individual components rather than entire matrices or vectors.

classes.name: ScalarizeArgsTraverser
classes.description: A traverser class that walks the AST to identify and scalarize vector and matrix constructor arguments.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes to determine if they match scalarization patterns and applies scalarization.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Visits block nodes to process contained statements.

methods.name: scalarizeArgs
methods.description: Performs the actual scalarization of vector or matrix constructor arguments.

methods.name: createTempVariable
methods.description: Creates a temporary variable to hold intermediate values during scalarization.
